name: lyhna-codex-adapter
description: Start and close local, evidence-scoped Lyhna witnessed runs in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Witness a Codex run and exact PR head.
interface.longDescription: Lyhna captures supported Codex lifecycle evidence, separates builder and evaluator capabilities, examines an exact GitHub PR head, and renders a local coverage-scoped receipt without becoming an approval authority.
interface.defaultPrompt: Start a Lyhna run, preserve the objective, use a distinct PR evaluator, retrieve its receipt, and leave the decision to me.
